q: Which one is a correct change of narration? He said to me, “Let me stay alone.”
o: He suggested to me that he should stay alone
He told me that he should stay alone
He requested me to let him stay alone
He proposed to me that he might stay alone
e: “Let me stay alone” একটি অনুরোধ, কারণ বক্তা শ্রোতার কাছে একা থাকতে দেওয়ার অনুমতি চাইছে। তাই indirect-এ requested + object + to let him ... বসে। সঠিক রূপ: He requested me to let him stay alone। Suggested বা proposed প্রস্তাবের ভাব আনে, আর told that he should বাধ্যবাধকতা বোঝায়; এগুলো মূল অর্থের সাথে মেলে না।

q: The headmaster says, “The inspector will visit our school at 11 am today.”
o: The Headmaster says that the Inspector will visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that the inspector will visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that the inspector is being visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that today at 11 am the inspector must visit their school
e: Reporting verb present (says) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। তাই will visit থাকে, আর our হয় their। Today-ও একই দিনের কথা বলায় বদলায় না। সঠিক রূপ: The Headmaster says that the Inspector will visit their school at 11 am today। Said বসালে reporting verb বদলে যায়, ‘is being visit’ গঠনগত ভুল, আর must অর্থ বদলে দেয়।

q: Change into direct speech: “He asked me where I had gone the previous day.”
o: He said to me, “Where did you go yesterday?”
He asked me, “Where have you gone yesterday?”
He asked me, “Where had you gone previous day?”
He asked me, “Where did you go previous day?”
e: Indirect-এর past perfect (had gone) direct-এ ফিরলে past indefinite (did go) হয় এবং the previous day ফিরে yesterday হয়। I হয় you, আর প্রশ্নের ক্রম ফিরে আসে: Where did you go? তাই “He said to me, ‘Where did you go yesterday?’” সঠিক। Have gone yesterday কালের দিক থেকে ভুল (yesterday-এর সাথে present perfect চলে না), আর বাকি অপশনে previous day রয়ে গেছে।

q: The direct speech of the sentence “He asked Karim to go with him” is:
o: He said to Karim, “Go with me.”
He told Karim, “Go with him.”
He asked Karim, “Go with his.”
He said to Karim, “Go with he.”
e: Indirect-এ asked someone to ... থাকলে direct-এ সাধারণত said to someone, “আদেশ বা অনুরোধ” হয়। Indirect-এর him (বক্তা নিজে) direct-এ me হয়, আর verb to ছাড়া বসে: “Go with me.” তাই “He said to Karim, ‘Go with me.’” সঠিক। Go with him বা go with his বসালে অন্য কাউকে বোঝায়, আর “go with he” case-এর দিক থেকে ভুল।

q: The poor man said, “Let me have some food.”
o: The poor man begged that I might had some food
The poor man begged that I might have some food
The poor man begged that he might had some food
The poor man begged that he might have some food
e: “Let me have ...” অনুনয় বা ভিক্ষা বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ begged that + subject + might + verb হয়। Me বদলে বক্তা poor man অনুযায়ী he হয়, আর might-এর পরে মূল verb have বসে, had নয়। সঠিক রূপ: The poor man begged that he might have some food। I রাখা এবং ‘might had’ লেখা দুটিই ভুল।

q: Munna said to Zuhan, “I shall come to you tomorrow.” Its indirect form is:
o: Munna told Zuhan that he would be going to him the next day
Munna told Zuhan that he would go to him the following day
Munna told Zuhan that he should come to him the following day
Munna informed Zuhan that he would come to him the following day
e: Said to হলে indirect-এ told বসে। Shall বদলে would হয়, tomorrow বদলে the following day হয়, আর you বদলে him হয়। ‘Come to you’ বক্তার দিকে আসা বোঝায়, তাই বর্ণনায় অন্যের দিকে যাওয়া বোঝাতে go ব্যবহৃত হয়। সঠিক রূপ: would go to him the following day। Would be going continuous হয়ে যায়, আর should এখানে বাধ্যবাধকতা আনে।

q: The man said, “Good morning, my friends.”
o: The man said that my friends good morning
The man bade his friends good morning
The man wished his friends good morning
The man addressing his friends good morning
e: Good morning জাতীয় শুভেচ্ছা indirect-এ wished দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়, আর সম্বোধিত ব্যক্তি object হয়: wished his friends good morning। My friends সম্বোধন, তাই my বদলে his হয়। সঠিক রূপ: The man wished his friends good morning। ‘Bade’-ও বিদায়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত, সাধারণ শুভেচ্ছায় wished মানানসই। বাকি অপশনে ক্রিয়াই নেই বা গঠন ভুল।

q: I said to you, “He has done his duty.” Make it indirect speech.
o: I said to you that you have done your duty
I said to you that he had done his duty
I told you that you had done your duty
I told you that he has done your duty
e: Reported speech-এর present perfect (has done) indirect-এ past perfect (had done) হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। He এখানে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তি, তাই he-ই থাকে এবং his duty-ও অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তাই “I said to you that he had done his duty”। অন্য অপশনে you/your বসে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তিকে শ্রোতা বানিয়ে ফেলা হয়েছে, আর ‘has done’ কাল বদলায়নি।

q: He has said to me, “I shall go out but you will stay.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay
He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He has said me that he would go out but I would stay
e: Reporting verb present perfect (has said) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। Said to হয়ে যায় told, তাই “has told me”। “I shall go” এর I হয় he, আর “you will stay” এর you হয় আমি (me-এর person অনুযায়ী) I। ফলে সঠিক রূপ: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay। অর্থ: সে আমাকে বলেছে সে বাইরে যাবে কিন্তু আমি থাকব।

q: Angel said, “I bought a pen yesterday.”
o: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that I had bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she bought a pen the day before
Angel said that she has bought a pen the day before
e: Past indefinite (bought) reporting verb past হলে past perfect (had bought) হয়, আর yesterday বদলে the day before হয়। I বদলে বক্তা Angel অনুযায়ী she হয়। সঠিক রূপ: Angel said that she had bought a pen the day before। I রেখে দিলে person ভুল, ‘bought’ রেখে দিলে কাল বদলানো হয়নি, আর ‘has bought’ present perfect, যা past reporting verb-এর সাথে চলে না।

q: Correct narration of the sentence: He said to me, “You cannot do it.”
o: He told me that I could not do it
He told me that I could not do that
He told me that I could not have done it
None of the above
e: Said to me থেকে হয় told me, আর can/cannot বদলে could/could not হয়। কর্তা you হয় I। Pronoun it indirect-এ বদলায় না, ‘that’-এ পরিণত হয় না (এ কারণে দ্বিতীয় অপশন ভুল)। সঠিক বাক্য: He told me that I could not do it। Could not have done অতীত না-পারা বোঝায়, তাই অর্থ পাল্টে যায়।

q: The teacher said to the student, “Do not waste time.” Its indirect form is:
o: The teacher told the student do not waste time
The teacher prohibited the students not to waste time
The teacher advised the student not to waste time
The teacher advised the student not to wasting time
e: “Do not ...” নিষেধ বা উপদেশ। Indirect-এ তা advised/forbade/told + object + not to + verb আকারে আসে। এখানে advised বেশি স্বাভাবিক: advised the student not to waste time। Prohibited-এর সাথে আবার not বললে দ্বিগুণ নেতিবাচক হয়। ‘not to wasting’ ভুল, কারণ to-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে। আর প্রথম অপশনে to-infinitive নেই।

q: He addressed Mr. Rahman and wished him good morning. (Change into direct speech.)
o: He said to Mr. Rahman, “Good morning.”
He said, “Good morning, Mr. Rahman.”
He said, “Good morning, to Mr. Rahman.”
He bade good morning to Mr. Rahman
e: Wished ... good morning-এর direct রূপে সম্বোধন (Mr. Rahman) শুভেচ্ছার পরে কমা দিয়ে বসে। তাই “He said, ‘Good morning, Mr. Rahman.’” সঠিক। অর্থ: সে মি. রহমানকে শুভ সকাল জানাল। Direct speech-এ ‘to Mr. Rahman’ বসানো অস্বাভাবিক, আর শেষ অপশনটি তো আসলে indirect রূপ, direct নয়। প্রথম অপশনেও সম্বোধন ঠিকমতো দেখানো হয়নি।

q: Change into direct speech: “He asked me when the next letter would come.”
o: He said to me, “When would the next letter come?”
He asked to me, “When will the next letter come?”
He said to me, “When will the next letter come?”
He said to me, “When the next letter will come?”
e: Indirect-এর would direct-এ ফিরলে will হয়, কারণ reported speech-এর future (will) reporting verb past হলে would হয়েছিল। প্রশ্নের ক্রম ফিরে আসে: When will the next letter come? এরপর asked বদলে said to হয়। তাই “He said to me, ‘When will the next letter come?’” সঠিক। অন্য অপশনে would রয়ে গেছে, asked to me ভুল, আর শব্দক্রম বিবৃতির মতো।

q: Which one is the correct indirect narration? “Why have you beaten my dog?” he said to me.
o: He demanded me why had I beaten his dog
He asked me why have had I beaten his dog
He enquired me why had I beaten his dog
He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের indirect-এ বাক্য বিবৃতির ক্রমে যায়: why I had beaten, কারণ প্রশ্নের ক্রম (why had I) থাকে না। Present perfect (have beaten) হয় past perfect (had beaten)। Demand/enquire-এর পরে of ব্যবহার করতে হয়: demanded of me। তাই “He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog” সঠিক। অন্য অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম বা of বাদ পড়েছে।

q: My friend said to me, “Go home at once.” (Change into indirect speech.)
o: My friend asked me go home at once
My friend asked me to go home at once
My friend said me go home at once
My friend told me to went home at once
e: Imperative আদেশ বা অনুরোধ indirect-এ reporting verb + object + to-infinitive হয়। এখানে asked/told/ordered চলে, আর অপশনের মধ্যে সঠিক গঠন “asked me to go home at once”। To-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে, তাই ‘to went’ ভুল। ‘asked me go’ এ to বাদ পড়েছে, আর ‘said me’ ব্যাকরণগত ভুল।

q: He said to me, “Did you take the examination?” The indirect form is:
o: He asked me did I take the examination
He asked to me if I took the examination
He asked me if I had given the examination
He asked me if I had taken the examination
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নে indirect-এ if বা whether বসে। Past indefinite (did take) বদলে past perfect (had taken) হয়, আর you হয় I। তাই “He asked me if I had taken the examination”। প্রথম অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, দ্বিতীয়টিতে asked to me ভুল (asked-এর পরে to হয় না), আর তৃতীয়টিতে take-এর বদলে give বসে অর্থ বদলে গেছে।

q: Anwer said, “Let him say whatever he likes.”
o: Anwer said that he may say whatever he liked
Anwer said that he might say whatever he liked
Anwer told that he might say whatever he likes
Anwer said that he might say whatever he likes
e: “Let him ...” অনুমতি বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ may/might বসে। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় might ব্যবহার হয়, আর পরের অংশ likes বদলে liked হয়। তাই “Anwer said that he might say whatever he liked”। May অতীত reporting verb-এর সাথে খাপ খায় না, told-এর পরে object লাগে, আর শেষ অপশনে likes কাল বদলায়নি।

q: Farida said to her mother, “I shall go to bed now.” Make it indirect speech.
o: Farida said to her mother that she should go to bed now
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed then
Farida said to her mother that she would go to bed then
Farida said to her mother that she should goes to bed now
e: Direct speech-এ shall বা will থাকলে, reporting verb past হলে, indirect-এ সেগুলো would হয়ে যায়। Now বদলে then বসে, আর I বদলে বক্তা Farida অনুযায়ী she হয়। তাই “she would go to bed then” (সে তখন ঘুমাতে যাবে বলল)। Should মানে বাধ্যবাধকতা, তাই অর্থ বদলে যায়। ‘should goes’ ব্যাকরণগত ভুল, আর will রাখলে কাল মিলে না।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, “What a beautiful bird!”
o: He said that what a beautiful bird it was
He exclaimed that it was a very beautiful bird
He exclaimed that what a beautiful bird
He said that it was a very beautiful bird
e: What a ... আবেগ প্রকাশ করে, তাই indirect-এ reporting verb হয় exclaimed (বা exclaimed with joy)। What a beautiful bird হয় a very beautiful bird, এবং is বদলে was হয়। সঠিক রূপ: He exclaimed that it was a very beautiful bird (সে বিস্ময়ে বলল পাখিটি খুব সুন্দর)। শুধু said বসালে আবেগ হারায়, আর what a ... রেখে দিলে গঠন ভুল হয়।

q: The manager said to the strikers, “Resume your work.”
o: The manager requested the strikers to resume their work
The manager ordered the strikers to resume their work
The manager told the strikers to resume their work
The manager requested to the strikers to resume their work
e: Please ছাড়া সরাসরি imperative আদেশ বোঝায়, আর ম্যানেজার কর্তৃত্বের জায়গা থেকে বলছেন, তাই indirect-এ ordered বসে। Ordered-এর পরে object (the strikers) সরাসরি বসে, তারপর to-infinitive। Your বদলে their হয়। অর্থ: ম্যানেজার ধর্মঘটীদের কাজে ফিরতে আদেশ দিলেন। Requested অনুরোধ বোঝায়, আর ‘requested to’ গঠনেও ভুল আছে।

q: We prayed that she ___ able to return in time. (CU (B7) 14-15)
o: will be
may be
would be
being
e: Prayed অতীত, তাই পরের clause-এ would বসে। তাই she would be able to return সঠিক। অর্থ: আমরা প্রার্থনা করেছিলাম সে যেন সময়মতো ফিরতে পারে। Will be ও may be বর্তমানের রূপ, যা অতীত main verb-এর সাথে মেলে না। Being একা finite verb হিসেবে বসে না। Pray-এর পরে অনেক সময় may বসে, কিন্তু অতীত হওয়ায় would চাই।

q: He said to me, “By God! I shall support you.”
o: He swore by God that he will support me
He swore by God that he will have supported me
He swear by God that he would have supported me
He swore by God that he would support me
e: শপথসূচক By God indirect-এ swore by God দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়। Shall বদলে would হয় (reporting verb past), I বদলে he এবং you বদলে me হয়। তাই “He swore by God that he would support me” (সে ঈশ্বরের নামে শপথ করে বলল সে আমাকে সমর্থন করবে)। ‘will’ বা ‘will have’ কাল ভুল, আর ‘swear’ past-এর জায়গায় ভুল রূপ।

q: He said to his friends, “Let us play now.”
o: He requested to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that they would play then
He proposed to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that we should play then
e: “Let us ...” প্রস্তাব, তাই indirect-এ proposed/suggested + that + they should বসে। Us বক্তা ও বন্ধুদের ধরে, সে কারণে we বদলে they হয়। Now বদলে then বসে। সঠিক রূপ: He proposed to his friends that they should play then। Would বসালে অর্থ বদলে যায়, we রাখা person ভুল, আর requested প্রস্তাবের চেয়ে অনুরোধ বোঝায়।

q: Find out the indirect narration of: He said, "I know this boy."
o: He said he knew this boy.
He said that he knew that boy.
He said that he knows this boy.
He said that he knew the boy.
e: Reporting verb said অতীতকালের, তাই know বদলে knew হয় এবং I বদলে he বসে। আরেকটি নিয়ম হলো, নির্দেশক শব্দ this বদলে that হয়। তাই সঠিক উত্তর 'He said that he knew that boy.'। অর্থ: সে বলল সে ঐ ছেলেটিকে চেনে। প্রথম অপশনে this থেকে গেছে, আর শেষ অপশনে this বদলে the হয়েছে, যা নিয়মসম্মত নয়। সূত্র: this হয়ে যায় that, here হয়ে যায় there।

q: The correct narration of 'He said, I am well'-
o: He said that I am well.
He said that I was well.
He said that he was well.
He said that he is well.
e: Reporting verb 'said' Past Indefinite, তাই indirect speech-এ reported অংশের tense এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়: am হয় was। Person-এ I বদলে he হয়, কারণ I বক্তা নিজেকেই বোঝায়। সঠিক রূপ 'He said that he was well.'। অর্থ: সে বলল যে সে ভালো আছে। 'I was well' বা 'he is well' দিলে person অথবা tense ভুল হয়। Reporting verb past হলে Present Indefinite হয়ে যায় Past Indefinite।
